units.source_text: 总算熬过冬天，春天来临了。

en.t: At last they had made it through the winter, and spring had come.

units.source_text: 三月初，收音机总算弄到了手，于是，屋顶上竖起了高高的天线。

en.t: At the beginning of March, they finally got hold of a radio, and a tall antenna was put up on the roof.

units.source_text: 女人十分幸福似的不停发出赞叹声，整个半天，都在左转右转摆旋钮。

en.t: The woman kept letting out cries of admiration as if she were perfectly happy, and for half the day she turned the dial this way and that.

units.source_text: 这个月的月底，女人怀孕了。

en.t: At the end of that month, the woman became pregnant.

units.source_text: 又过了两个月，大白鸟由西向东飞了三天之后的第二天，女人突然血染下半身，还说疼痛难熬。

en.t: Two more months passed, and on the day after great white birds had flown from west to east for three days, the woman suddenly had blood all over her lower body and said the pain was unbearable.

units.source_text: 村落里有人的亲戚是个兽医，诊断说可能是“宫外孕”，

en.t: Someone in the village had a relative who was a veterinarian, and after examining her he said it might be an ectopic pregnancy,

units.source_text: 赶快叫三轮摩托车，要把她送到镇上医院去。

en.t: so they hurriedly called for a three-wheeled motorbike to take her to the hospital in town.

units.source_text: 三轮摩托车还没有到来之前，男人紧靠着女人，

en.t: Before the three-wheeled motorbike arrived, the man stayed pressed close against the woman,

units.source_text: 一只手托着她的身子，空着的一只手，不停地抚摸女人的腰部。

en.t: supporting her body with one hand while his free hand kept stroking her waist.
